app.name: Rumbo
app.tagline: Clear onboarding journeys for every new hire, their manager, and HR.
app.demoNotice: This is a demo: don't enter real data.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this page
notFound.body: Check the address or go back to the home page.

ui.maskRejected: That character isn't allowed in this field. Current value: {{value}}

validation.required: This field is required. Fill it in to continue.
validation.email: Enter an email in the format first.last@nortia.demo
validation.dateFormat: Enter the full date as DD/MM/YYYY, for example: 13/10/2026
validation.dateInvalid: That date doesn't exist. Check the day and month
validation.integer: Enter a whole number, for example: -3 or 5
validation.offsetRange: Enter a number of days between {{min}} and {{max}}
validation.otp: Enter the 6 digits of the code

login.title: Sign in to Rumbo
login.subtitle: Use your Nortia work account.
login.emailToggle: Sign in with email and password
login.emailHelp: Your work email, for example: first.last@nortia.demo
login.passwordHelp: Your Nortia account password. In the demo it's Demo.2026!
login.invalid: Incorrect email or password. Check your details and try again.
login.attemptsWarning: For security, the account is locked after {{max}} failed attempts.
login.lockedTitle: Access to this account is locked
login.lockedBody: For security, we lock access after several failed attempts. Only IT can restore it, after verifying your identity.
login.resetBody: All changes go back to their initial state and you're signed out.

logout.expired: We signed you out after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to continue.
logout.reset: We reset the demo. All data is back to its initial state.

demo.title: Explore the demo
demo.subtitle: Sign in with one click as any of the four roles. The verification code is already filled in.

description.admin: Designs templates, adds new hires and tracks progress.
description.manager: Supports their team with 30, 60 and 90-day check-ins.
description.hire: Goes through onboarding: tasks, courses and check-ins.
description.it_admin: Handles access requests and reviews the audit log.

preview.title: Everyone knows what to do, with whom and by when.

sso.title: Connecting to {{provider}}
sso.redirecting: Redirecting you to Nortia's identity provider…
sso.simulated: Simulation: the demo never leaves Rumbo and sends no data.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.demoCode: Demo: the code is {{code}} and it's already filled in.
mfa.codeHelp: The 6 digits from your authenticator app. You can paste it
mfa.backupHelp: One of the 8-digit codes you saved when you turned on verification
mfa.rememberHelp: We won't ask for a code on this computer until {{date}}.
mfa.invalid: We couldn't verify the code. Check that it has 6 digits and matches the one in the app now.
mfa.invalidBackup: We couldn't verify the backup code. Check that it has 8 digits.
mfa.relink: IT reset your two-step verification. Link your authenticator app again, then enter the code.
mfa.cancel: Cancel and sign in with another account

newPassword.title: Create a new password
newPassword.subtitle: IT asked you to change your password. Choose one that meets every requirement.
newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.help: It must meet every requirement in the list.
newPassword.invalid: The password doesn't meet every requirement yet.

accessHelp.title: Trouble signing in
accessHelp.intro: Rumbo accounts are work accounts, and access is managed by Nortia's IT team. For security, an account can't be recovered or unlocked from this screen.
accessHelp.ssoTitle: If you sign in with Microsoft or Google
accessHelp.ssoBody: Your password is your company account password. IT changes it, not this platform.
accessHelp.hours: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.
accessHelp.formIntro: Fill in the form. IT will verify your identity before restoring access.
accessHelp.reasonHelp: Choose the option that best describes what's happening.

reasons.mfa_issue: I don't receive the verification code

accessHelp.reasonRequired: Choose the reason for your request.
accessHelp.commentHelp: Anything that helps IT, for example: since when it's been happening.
accessHelp.demoTip: Demo: type #error in the comment to see how a service error is shown.
accessHelp.serverErrorBody: We couldn't send your request. Your details are still here: try again in a few seconds.
accessHelp.confirmBody: If the email belongs to a Nortia account, IT will verify your identity before restoring access and will contact you through your registered channels.
accessHelp.confirmKeep: Keep the number to follow up with the help desk.

session.warningTitle: Your session is about to expire
session.warningBody: For security, we sign you out after {{minutes}} minutes of inactivity.

security.title: My security
security.subtitle: How access to your Rumbo account is protected.
security.mfaRequired: It's required for your role by Nortia's security policy.
security.mfaOptional: It's optional for your role. We recommend keeping it on.
security.mfaRequiredReason: Nortia's policy doesn't allow turning it off for your role
security.noDevices: No remembered devices. When you verify the code, you can choose to remember this computer for 30 days.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this section
forbidden.body: This section belongs to another role. If you think you need access, ask HR.

upcoming.body: We're building this screen. Meanwhile, use the "View as" selector to explore Rumbo from another role.
